item.title: UKMTO publishes 8 or more Attack reports within 900 km of Bandar Abbas, 23-29 Nov 2026
item.summary: 55% chance UKMTO publishes 8 or more Attack reports for incidents within 900 km of Bandar Abbas between 00:00 UTC 23 Nov and 23:59 UTC 29 Nov 2026: weekly counts since 28 Sep ran 8, 10, 11, 3, 6, 8 and 4.

alternatives.hypothesis: The tempo stays at November's lower rate (3 to 6 a week)
alternatives.tell_apart: a count of 3 to 6 Attack reports in the window
a count above 11 in the window

resolution.rule: Yes if UKMTO's incident list (ukmto.org, the list Wake reads) shows 8 or more reports of type "Attack" whose creation time (utcDateCreated) falls from 00:00 UTC 23 Nov 2026 to 23:59 UTC 29 Nov 2026 and whose position lies within 900 km of 27.218 N 56.378 E; counted on a check after 00:00 UTC on 30 Nov 2026, with the list saved at the check. No otherwise.
resolution.source: UKMTO (UK Maritime Trade Operations, Royal Navy) incident list, via Wake's wake:ukmto items

reference.basis: Rolling 7-day counts of UKMTO Attack reports within 900 km of Bandar Abbas, one a day from 6 Oct to 18 Nov 2026, reached 8 or more on 18 of 44 (41%). UKMTO's list, read 18 Nov 2026 16:44 UTC; type, time and position only.

sources.licence: UK Crown copyright, reports as published (type, time and position only)
sources.descriptor: UKMTO's incident list: 54 reports in the circle from 30 Sep to 18 Nov 2026; Monday-to-Sunday weeks since 28 Sep: 8, 10, 11, 3, 6, 8, 4

item.title: IMF PortWatch's 7-day mean of Strait of Hormuz transits is 4.0 a day or more on 29 Nov 2026
item.summary: 40% chance IMF PortWatch's 7-day rolling mean of vessel transits through the Strait of Hormuz is 4.0 a day or more on 29 Nov 2026 (28 or more transits in the 7 days, above the 90-day median of 3.86): the week to 15 Nov was 2.29 a day, the lowest of those 90 days.

alternatives.hypothesis: Traffic stays at its floor (about 2 a day)

alternatives.tell_apart: a 7-day mean well above 5 on 29 Nov

resolution.rule: Yes if IMF PortWatch Daily_Chokepoints_Data (portid='chokepoint6') reports a 7-day rolling n_total >= 4.0 vessels/day (28 or more transits in the 7 days to 29 Nov, above the 90-day median of 3.86 vessels/day) on 2026-11-29 UTC.
resolution.source: IMF PortWatch Daily_Chokepoints_Data (https://portwatch.imf.org/), via Wake; the IMF does not endorse the analysis
resolution.void_if: PortWatch publishes no Strait of Hormuz counts for 23-29 Nov 2026 by 20 Dec 2026

reference.basis: Wake's PortWatch fixture (chokepoint6 daily n_total, 20 Sep 2025 to 8 Nov 2026, read 15 Nov): of the 33 days in 2026 with a 7-day mean below 3.0, 20 (61%) were followed 14 days later by a 7-day mean of 4.0 or more; over the 90 days to 8 Nov the mean was 4.0 or more on 44 (49%). Days are autocorrelated, so few independent spells stand behind the 61%.

sources.licence: IMF PortWatch terms; the IMF does not endorse the analysis
sources.descriptor: Strait of Hormuz, 7-day mean 2.29 transits a day in the week to 15 Nov 2026, against a 90-day median of 3.86 (z -2.5)

item.title: Blackout reports a confirmed internet outage in a Gulf state, Iran or Iraq beginning 23 Nov-6 Dec 2026
item.summary: 15% chance Blackout reports a confirmed internet outage in Iran, the UAE, Oman, Qatar, Bahrain, Kuwait, Saudi Arabia or Iraq that begins between 00:00 UTC 23 Nov and 23:59 UTC 6 Dec 2026: Access Now's STOP documents 6 shutdowns in Iran and 7 in Iraq in 2025 (Iraq's all between February and August), none in the other six.

alternatives.hypothesis: Connectivity holds, as on every day since Blackout joined COP on 12 Nov
alternatives.tell_apart: no BO-IND-1, -9 or -10 item naming one of the eight in the window

alternatives.hypothesis: A fault on one network only (still Yes if Cloudflare verified it)
alternatives.tell_apart: a BO-IND-10 item naming one network, with no country-level IODA outage

resolution.rule: Yes if Blackout's feed, or COP's suite ledger of it, carries a confirmed outage naming Iran, the UAE, Oman, Qatar, Bahrain, Kuwait, Saudi Arabia or Iraq that began from 00:00 UTC 23 Nov 2026 to 23:59 UTC 6 Dec 2026: an IODA country-level outage (BO-IND-1), a Cloudflare-verified traffic anomaly (BO-IND-10) or a Cloudflare Radar Outage Center entry (BO-IND-9); counted on a check after 00:00 UTC on 7 Dec 2026. A single-signal dip (BO-IND-4), a route leak or a hijack does not count. No otherwise.
resolution.source: Blackout (IODA; Cloudflare Radar, CC BY-NC 4.0), through COP's suite ledger

reference.basis: Access Now #KeepItOn STOP, 2025: 6 documented shutdowns in Iran (5 in June, 1 in December, so about 2 episodes) and 7 in Iraq (all February to August, exam months), none in the other six. Counting records, a 14-day window holds one 21% of the time; counting Iran's episodes, about 7%; Iraq adds little in late Nov. A few points added for network faults Cloudflare verifies, which STOP doesn't count.
